api-key.description: **Recommended.** Signvoy API key. Create one in Workspace Settings → API Keys and pass it as `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...`. The key implies its workspace, so `X-Workspace-Id` is optional when using an API key.

clerk-jwt.description: Clerk session JWT — used internally by the Signvoy dashboard. Not recommended for external integrations; use an API key instead.

workspace-id.name: X-Workspace-Id
workspace-id.description: Workspace ID for multi-tenancy. Optional when authenticating with an API key (the key already implies its workspace).

slug.description: URL-friendly slug (auto-generated from name if omitted). Must be lowercase alphanumeric with optional hyphens.
Updated URL-friendly slug. Must be lowercase alphanumeric with optional hyphens.

email.description: Email address of the person to invite

role.description: New role for the member. Note: Owner role cannot be assigned via this endpoint.

included.description: Seats bundled with the current plan

allowed.description: Seats the account may fill (included + purchased)

used.description: Seats in use: distinct members across every workspace on the account, plus pending invitations to addresses that are not already members

sent.description: Documents sent in the current billing period

limit.description: Documents included per period; null means unlimited

customBranding.description: Custom logo and colours; Signvoy branding removed

customEmailSender.description: Custom from / reply-to address on signing emails

sharedTemplates.description: Templates shared with the whole workspace

workspaceWideVisibility.description: Members can see every document in the workspace

annualMonthlyUsd.description: Effective monthly price when billed annually, in USD

plan.description: Plan on the subscription, i.e. what the account pays for

effectivePlan.description: Plan actually in force. Differs from `plan` only when the subscription has lapsed, in which case entitlements fall back to Free.

status.description: Stripe subscription status; null on an account that never paid

cancelAtPeriodEnd.description: Whether the subscription stops at the end of the period

currentPeriodEnd.description: End of the current billing period; null on Free

hasBillingHistory.description: Whether this account has ever reached checkout, and therefore whether the Customer Portal has invoices and a payment method to show

extraSeatMonthlyUsd.description: Price per extra seat per month, in USD

extraSeatAnnualUsd.description: Price per extra seat per month when billed annually, in USD

plan.description: Plan to subscribe to or move to

interval.description: Billing interval. Annual is billed once for twelve months at a 20% discount.

seats.description: Total seats to buy, including the ones the plan already bundles — the same number the dashboard displays. Omit it to buy exactly what the plan bundles, or what the account already occupies if that is more. Values below the seats currently in use are raised to that floor.

url.description: Stripe-hosted URL to send the browser to

seats.description: Total seats the account should have, including the ones the plan already bundles — the same number the dashboard displays. Requests below the seats currently in use are raised to that floor rather than rejected, so members are never billed out from under.

plan.description: Plan to buy. Free needs no payment and Enterprise is a sales conversation.

interval.description: Billing interval. Annual is billed once for twelve months at a 20% discount.

seats.description: Total seats to buy, including the ones the plan bundles. Omit it to buy exactly what the plan bundles. Values below that are raised to it.
Total seats bought, including those the plan bundles

email.description: Email Stripe collected. The subscription is attached to an account for this address, so it is the address the buyer must sign in with.

paid.description: Whether the payment has settled. Delayed payment methods can complete a session while the charge is still pending.

fileName.description: Original PDF filename. Required for a pdf source; omit it for a document source, which has no uploaded file.

pageCount.description: Number of pages. Required for a pdf source; omit it for a document source, whose length is only known once the body is rendered.

content.description: Optional initial draft content (recipients/fields/rules, plus the `sourceFiles` manifest when several PDFs were merged on upload). Pass a body with `sourceKind: "document"` to author the template as rich text instead of uploading a PDF.

kind.description: Whether this is a reusable template or the single-use container behind a one-off document. One-off templates are hidden from the templates list and are published implicitly when a document is created from them.

draftVersionId.description: ID of the initial draft version

uploadUrl.description: Presigned PUT URL for uploading the source PDF directly to storage. Upload the PDF bytes to this URL with Content-Type: application/pdf. Absent for a document-source template, which has no file to upload — its PDF is rendered from the body at signing time.

publishedBy.description: Clerk user ID of the publisher

pdfUrl.description: Presigned PDF URL (included when explicitly requested)

ownerId.description: Clerk user ID of the owner

kind.description: Reusable templates appear in the templates list. One-off templates back a single 'upload and send' document and are hidden from every listing.

archivedAt.description: Unix ms when archived (null if active)

draftVersion.description: Current draft version (null if none exists)

publishedVersion.description: Current published version (null if never published)

enabled.description: Whether automatic reminders are enabled for this document

maxReminders.description: Maximum number of automatic reminders before giving up

days.description: Days after sending that this document can still be signed. The absolute deadline is derived from this when the document is sent.

roleKey.description: Template role key this recipient fills (matches `version.content.recipients[].key`). Required for `signer`; ignored for `cc` and `viewer`, which hold no fields and are assigned a synthetic key.

type.description: What this recipient is asked to do. `signer` (default) fills in fields and signs. `cc` receives a copy and never holds up the signing order. `viewer` must open and confirm they reviewed the document, and blocks the order until they do.

order.description: Position in the signing order. Signers default to the order set on their template role. For a `cc` this is also *when* the copy is sent: a position after every signer gets the certified final document, while a mid-order position gets the document as it stands at that step.

templateId.description: Template UUID to create document from

message.description: Message to include with the signing request
message.example: Please review and sign this document at your earliest convenience.

emailSubject.description: Replaces the generated subject line on the signing request, the awaiting-your-turn heads-up, and reminders (which stay prefixed with "Reminder: "). Completion, decline, void and expiry notices always use their standard wording. Leave unset for the generated subject.

routingMode.description: Signing-order mode. parallel (default): all recipients are invited at once. sequential: recipients are activated group-by-group by ascending order value — the next group is only activated once the current group has fully signed.

reminders.description: Automatic reminder cadence for this document. When omitted, the template's reminder default (or the product default) is used.

expiry.description: Signing deadline for this document. When omitted, the template's deadline default (or the product default) is used.

recipients.description: Everyone involved with the document, in signing order — those who sign, those who must view and confirm, and those who just receive a copy. At least one must sign or view.

roleName.description: Role display name snapshot at send time

type.description: What this recipient is asked to do. `signer` fills in fields and signs. `cc` receives a copy and never holds up the signing order. `viewer` must open and confirm they reviewed the document.

color.description: Hex colour assigned to this recipient

status.description: Each role reaches its own terminal status: a signer `signed`, a viewer `acknowledged`, a CC `copy_sent`. They are never interchangeable.

signedAt.description: Unix ms timestamp when recipient signed

declinedAt.description: Unix ms timestamp when recipient declined

signUrl.description: URL where this recipient can complete signing

lastRemindedAt.description: Unix ms timestamp when recipient was last reminded (manual or automatic)

hasActiveSigningLink.description: Whether this recipient has an active signing link (can currently sign)

ownerId.description: Clerk user ID of the document owner

message.description: Custom message sent with the signing request

emailSubject.description: Sender's replacement subject for the signing request and reminders. Absent means the generated subject is used.

documentHash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the certified final PDF

lastReminderAt.description: Unix ms of the most recent reminder (auto or manual)

sendBlockers.description: Reasons a draft cannot yet be sent. Empty array when the document is ready to send or is not in draft state.

message.description: Message to include with the signing request
message.example: Please review and sign this document at your earliest convenience.

routingMode.description: Signing-order mode. parallel (default): all recipients are invited at once. sequential: recipients are activated group-by-group by ascending order value — the next group is only activated once the current group has fully signed.

reminders.description: Automatic reminder cadence for this document. When omitted, the template's reminder default (or the product default) is used.

expiry.description: Signing deadline for this document. When omitted, the template's deadline default (or the product default) is used.

recipients.description: Everyone involved with the document, in signing order — those who sign, those who must view and confirm, and those who just receive a copy. At least one must sign or view.

values.description: Field values as key-value pairs (fieldId -> value)
Completed field values as key-value pairs (fieldId -> value)

consentAcceptedAt.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when consent was accepted

reason.description: Optional reason for declining to sign
reason.example: I need more time to review

pageCount.description: Page count of the seed PDF. Meaningful only for `sourceKind: 'pdf'` — a document-source template has no fixed page count until it is frozen at publish.

sourceKind.description: `document` for content-native rich-text templates, `pdf` for templates built on an uploaded file.

recipients.description: Signers, with the colours their fields are drawn in.

previewUrl.description: Short-lived presigned URL for the seed PDF. Only present on the detail response and only for `sourceKind: 'pdf'` — document templates are rendered client-side from `content.body`.

content.description: Full normalized template content: recipients, fields, rules, and (for document source) the rich-text body. Detail response only.
